description:
We are a passionate team of innovators and tech enthusiasts interested in web development, AI, software development, and creative problem-solving. Our goal is to turn innovative ideas into real-world solutions through teamwork and creativity.

Join ORBITX to learn, collaborate, explore new technologies, and build exciting projects together!

Looking for: Frontend/Backend Developers, Python or Java Programmers, AI/ML Enthusiasts, UI/UX Designers, and Creative Problem Solvers.
